content:
This looks pretty interesting. ChatGPT's latest update adds a new Mac integration feature: it can handle conversations in Apple's Messages app. The feature supports iMessage, SMS, and RCS.

ChatGPT for Mac now has an Apple Messages plugin

The new Apple Messages plugin allows ChatGPT to read and search chat histories on Mac, and prepare and send messages. OpenAI says the feature is available for all tiers of the macOS ChatGPT desktop app, including ChatGPT Work and Codex.

This access raises privacy and control concerns, so OpenAI emphasizes that sending actions still require user approval by default. Users should be doubly careful before granting long-term authorization. OpenAI's plugin guide details the associated risks, how to revoke access, and a known issue involving a task that disables the approval prompt.

This link should jump directly to the Messages plugin in ChatGPT for Mac.

Shared site co-editing, conversation snapshot features, and more

Although the Messages plugin is the most eye-catching new addition for Apple users, this update also includes several other improvements. For example, pinned conversations can now sync between the ChatGPT desktop app and iOS, making it convenient for users to access important conversations anytime between Mac and iPhone.

ChatGPT also added the ability to share local Codex conversation snapshots as read-only. These snapshots will not change as the original conversation updates.

Links created by personal accounts can be accessed by anyone with that URL, while workspace links are only open to members of that workspace. OpenAI says Codex masks known sensitive formats, but reminds users to always review snapshot content, as sensitive information may still remain.

Additionally, site owners can invite active members within the same workspace to co-edit sites that support collaboration. Editors can update content and database data, save versions, and publish modifications after the owner completes the initial publish. Owners retain control over access, settings, analytics, and version restore.

Some site owners can also change the URL hosted by ChatGPT without redeploying, with the old URL automatically redirecting to the new URL.

Finally, the "Computer Use History" feature launched last week will expand to Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. This optional feature requires the "Memory" feature to be enabled and is off by default.
